name: Annabelle
source:
Annabelle is Sophia's mother and daughter to Ophelia. She seems to always be annoyed and ready to explode into a rage, as easy to touch off as a vial of nitroglycerine. She is also incredibly haughty, she had Sophia via sperm donation as she considers no man worthy of touching her, much less have sex with her. She is thus technically a virgin despite being a mother. She does not even masturbate as "a classy lady" (which she regards herself as) does not do such things!

After having gotten the door slammed in his face when the protagonist came to visit Ophelia regarding a job opening, he let himself in (Annabelle didn't lock it) and found Ophelia on her own. Ophelia does regretfully admit that Annabelle is spoiled rotten and lacks discipline but that she (Ophelia) has lost control over her daughter. The protagonist suggest that she might need a good spanking! 

While needing to use the toilet during his visit, Annabelle walks in on the protagonist while he is doing his business. Instead of excusing herself for the mistake, she again flies into a rage, accusing him of being a pervert and rapist(!) and starting to hit him in the face with her fists, causing a nosebleed! (While the protagonist has done his fair share of accidental exposures in the past, in this case there was a perfectly legit reason to have his penis out.)

Despite her and Sophia living in Ophelia's huge, mansion-like, house, and getting a incredibly generous allowance from Ophelia ($15000/month!), she does not show a smidgen of gratefulness. Instead, she regards the house as hers and she screams at her mother, telling her that she hates her and wishes she was dead! At this point, the protagonist intervenes and, obliquely asks Ophelia if she remembers what he suggested earlier. Ophelia blanches but excuses herself from the room, after telling Annabelle to do everything the protagonist says, or she will be without allowance for six months! 

The protagonist proceeds to give Annabelle a spanking (while gagging her by sticking a banana in her mouth) and then marching her to Ophelia's room to apologise, which she does, meekly. (Afterwards, Ophelia says that she should be outraged that the protagonist actually did spank her daughter but that she can't argue with the results and thanks him instead.) There is an indication that Annabelle did get turned on by the manhandling and humiliation, not that she would ever admit to it.

A while later when Ophelia has given the protagonist control over Annabelle's disciplining, Annabelle again starts threatening to report him for rape. The MC calmly calls the police department on speakerphone. As soon as Annabelle starts screaming about rape, the police on the other end says that she will be arrested for false accusations is she persists in making fake rape-reports. It turns out to be Sandra that answered and, as soon as she and the protagonist realises who is on the other end, offers to lend the MC handcuffs, baton, or even a taser if he would need it to dicipline Annabelle.
